svg.desc: Heating a gas or reducing molar mass shifts the distribution to higher speeds, broadens it, and lowers its peak. Cooling or increasing molar mass shifts it to lower speeds, narrows it, and raises its peak. All four panels use the same reference and axis scales.
svg.title: Four speed-distribution comparisons with a shared reference curve
